subject.title: fix(ui): apply Context Profile presets via config.patch to avoid SecretRef rejection

question: What should Context Profile Apply do when the Raw JSON editor contains unsaved changes?
rationale: The PR must choose one authoritative editor-state contract; preserving an unchanged dirty raw document after mutating the server creates a later silent rollback, while rewriting that document may alter user-authored raw content.

options.title: Block Until Raw Is Clean
options.body: Disable preset Apply while Raw JSON is dirty and prompt the user to save or discard those edits before issuing `config.patch`.

options.title: Merge Into Raw Draft
options.body: Apply the preset to both the server and dirty raw buffer, with explicit formatting and round-trip guarantees plus upgrade-focused tests.

options.title: Stage Presets In Raw Mode
options.body: Make preset selection draft-only while Raw mode is active and defer all writes until the user submits that editor.

recommendation.title: Block Until Raw Is Clean
recommendation.body: Disable preset Apply while Raw JSON is dirty and prompt the user to save or discard those edits before issuing `config.patch`.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history owns the closest SecretRef and config-write reconciliation contract.
